API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIAppProtection Control ManagementUpdates the existing custom control for the specified ID.
Updates the existing custom control for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/inspectionControls/custom/:id

Updates the existing custom control for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the AppProtection control.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
action
string

The action of the custom control.

Possible values: [PASS, BLOCK, REDIRECT, ALLOW]

actionValue
string

Denotes the action. Supports any string.

associatedInspectionProfileNames
NameIdDto[]
controlException
InspectionControlExceptions
controlNumber
int32

The AppProtection control number.

controlRuleJson
string

The AppProtection control rule.

controlType
string

The control type of the custom control.

Possible values: [WEBSOCKET_PREDEFINED, WEBSOCKET_CUSTOM, THREATLABZ, CUSTOM, PREDEFINED, API_PREDEFINED, ADP_PREDEFINED]

creationTime
int32

The time the custom control is created.

defaultAction
string

The performed action.

Possible values: [PASS, BLOCK, REDIRECT, ALLOW]

defaultActionValue
string

Used to provide the redirect URL if the default action is set to REDIRECT.

description
string

The description of the custom control.

id
int64

The unique identifier of the AppProtection custom control.

modifiedBy
int64

The unique identifier of the tenant who modified the custom control.

modifiedTime
int32

The time the custom control is modified.

name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the custom control.

paranoiaLevel
int32

The OWASP Predefined Paranoia Level. To learn more, see Configuring AppProtection Profiles.

protocolType
string

The protocol type of the custom control.

Possible values: [HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, RDP, SSH, WEBSOCKET, VNC, REALVNC, NONE, AUTO, DYNAMIC, KRB, LDAP, SMB]

rules
InspectionRule[]
severity
string

The severity of the AppProtection control number. To learn more, see About AppProtection Controls.

Possible values: [CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO]

type
string

The rules to be applied to the request or response type.

Possible values: [REQUEST, RESPONSE]

version
string

The predefined control version.

Responses
​
204
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

No Content
